top_issues: Home + Pay + Account + Swap: bilateral bars are not on one absolute scale — Home's $11,500 composition bar is roughly the same drawn length as Hub One's $60,000 / $40,000 capacity bar; 1 px = $N from Settings is not applied.
Home + Pay + Account + Swap: left half is labeled send-up-to 60,000.00 (59,975.00 later) but draws shorter than the right half labeled receive-up-to 40,000.00 — bigger money is not a bigger bar.

Home desktop: the On-chain / Reserve / Accounts legend under the total repeats the three numbers already encoded in the composition bar; the Instant send/receive line then repeats the same 60k/40k already on the Hub One card.
Home + Activity: two identical 'Credit limit updated · with Hub One · 50,000.00 USDC' rows cannot be told apart (no time, no old→new, no frame).
Home BALANCES: 11,500.00 has no $ while Total balance is $11,500.00; Accounts card shows +10,000.00 with currency only in the tiny USDC caption.
fixes: Draw every bar at the Settings scale with a hard clip/fade when it overflows the column; do not fit-to-width. At 1 px = $10, $11,500 = 1,150 px clipped; $60,000 send = 6,000 px clipped — the $11.5k bar must read as a stub next to capacity.
Left/right halves: length(left) / sendCapacity === length(right) / receiveCapacity, notch at 0. 60k left must be 1.5× 40k right.
Delete the three-color legend under Total balance. Keep one caption: 'On-chain $0 · Reserve $1,500 · Accounts $10,000' as the bar's own label, or only on hover.
Replace '2 empty hidden' with a text button 'Show 2 empty' in the same 12px caption style as Settings section labels.
One money format everywhere: $11,500.00 on Total, Balances, Accounts, and Recents when the unit is USD-pegged; otherwise 11,500.00 USDC with tabular figures, never mixed.

top_issues: Pay desktop: route is drawn three times — You→Hub One→Meridian Desk chips, the Route/Fee/Arrives table, and the right-hand ROUTE timeline.
Pay Amount card: a stray bullet under 'This payment' with no icon/label; reads as a broken row.
Pay: fee disagrees with itself — ROUTE says 'fee 0.000025', table says 0.000050 USDC.
Pay To: full 40-byte hex on one line (0x499d0dc46b549f…ef2bd) in 12px gray; it is a dump, not a field.
Pay Before/After: the two Hub One bars are visually identical for a $25 delta, so the comparison does no work (honest at true scale, but then the second bar is decoration).
fixes: Keep the right ROUTE timeline; delete the chip row and the Route table row. Fee, Arrives, Delivery stay as a 3-row spec under Amount.
Remove the orphan bullet. 'This payment 25.00' should be one caption+tabular pair, 13/15px, no glyph.
One fee: show 0.000025 USDC (or 0.000050) in both the timeline and the spec; never both.
To card: Meridian Desk + copyable 0x499d…f2bd (6+4), 13px, trailing copy glyph. Full hex only in a click-to-expand.
Before/After: keep one bar (After). Put '−25.00' on the notch and '9,975.00 owes you' as the headline; drop the duplicate Before bar.

top_issues: Receipt + Receive + Swap + Account: toast 'Payment submitted: 25.00 USDC to Meridian Desk' stays up after the modal already says PAID / Settled — two states for one payment.
Receipt Frame #40 vs Activity detail / Settings Frame #41 for the same −25.00 USDC payment.
Receipt: 'Instantly · 2041ms' is a debug timer in the settled row; Instant and 2.0s are the product words.
Receipt desktop: a phone-sized centered sheet plus a toast sitting on the same vertical axis; Done and the X both dismiss.
fixes: Dismiss the submitted toast when the committed receipt opens. If a toast is needed, 'Paid 25.00 USDC to Meridian Desk' once, then never again on Receive/Swap/Account.
One frame id per payment: the receipt, the activity panel, and Settings Frame must print the same #.
Settled row: 'Instant' in mint; move '2.041s' next to Proof as secondary evidence.
Desktop receipt: 480px modal, no second dismiss. X or Done, not both. Keep Proof + 'Verified by your runtime'.

top_issues: Receive desktop: a single centered phone column (QR, amount, note, hex, three copy actions) on a wide canvas — Pay's two-column pattern is abandoned.
Receive Amount 0.00 sits on a full-width indigo fade that reads as a money bar for zero; it is neither the $0 amount nor a labeled send/receive capacity bar with a notch.
Receive: three copy CTAs — Copy invoice, Copy link, Copy xln:// app link — with no hierarchy of what the payer should actually open.
Receive: YOUR ENTITY ID dumps the full 0xf581ad…e476b string with no copy control on the field itself.
fixes: Reuse Pay's two-column grid: left QR + amount + note + one primary copy; right 'YOUR ACCOUNTS' with the Hub One send/receive bar at the same px scale.
If amount is 0.00, draw no bar. If the line is 'receive up to 40,025', use the standard notched bilateral bar, not a decorative underline.
One primary: 'Copy link'. Invoice and xln:// as 13px text links under it, not a second 48px button.
Entity id: 0xf581…476b + copy glyph, 13px. Kill the raw 64-char row.

top_issues: Swap: You pay 100 USDC / You receive 0.00 WETH with a still-visible Swap CTA — no rate, no min received, no 'no quote' reason. Unsafe to move money.
Swap CTA is washed lavender (#B8C0FF-like) on light gray; it is neither a disabled state with a reason nor the indigo Pay treatment.
Swap: 100 USDC has no bar; Receive's 0.00 had a bar; Hub One card on the right is a stub over a desert of empty canvas.
Swap copy: 'Filled amounts move Δ, nothing moves on-chain.' is protocol jargon in the only explanation.
fixes: No quote: disable Swap, 40% opacity, caption under the button 'No WETH quote from Hub One'. Never show 0.00 as a receivable amount.
When a quote exists: You receive N.NNNN WETH, rate 1 USDC = x WETH, min received, then indigo 'Swap 100.00 USDC'.
Draw the 100 USDC you-pay amount as a bar at the same 1 px = $N as Home; keep the Hub One capacity bar on that same scale.
Replace the Δ sentence with: 'This order sits on your Hub One account. Nothing is broadcast on-chain until it fills.'

top_issues: Account desktop: Hub One is a narrow centered stack (actions + one token card) — same unused-width failure as Receive.

Account legend (collateral green / credit line blue / owed amber / in flight hatch) is a 4-color key for a bar that is flat amber|blue; collateral 0.00 and in-flight are not drawn, and owed +9,975 is not a segment of the 59,975 left half.
Account: +9,975.00 'they owe you' is the headline, but the bar's amber reads as the whole send capacity, so the owed slice is invisible.
Account actions: Pay / Extend credit / Swap as three equal 48px cards; Extend credit is the only account-specific verb and is visually equal to Swap.
fixes: Two-column: left = identity, actions, USDC lane; right = ledger preview + last 5 movements with this counterparty (same master-detail as Activity).

Drop the four-swatch legend, or actually paint the left half as stacked segments: owed 9,975 amber + your credit remaining 50,000 indigo + collateral 0, hatch in-flight. Right half = their remaining credit 40,025.
Put 'they owe you +9,975.00' as a labeled tick on the left half, not only as a headline that the bar ignores.
Primary: Pay (indigo). Extend credit and Swap as ghost buttons, 44px, not a third twin of Pay.

top_issues: Activity desktop: right column is an empty 'Select a movement to see its receipt.' card while −25.00 Sent is sitting right there — master-detail with no default selection.
Activity list: −25.00 and +10,000.00 are the same row height, same type size, same mint 'settled' — no bar, so the $10k is not bigger than $25.
Activity filters: All is a black pill on a light canvas (heavy, off-accent); Settlement as a filter name collides with the settled status on payment rows.
fixes: On desktop load, select the latest movement and open its receipt in the right column (the 08 state). Empty copy only when the filtered list is empty.
Each payment row gets a 4px-tall bar at 1 px = $N before the amount: +10,000.00 is 400× the −25.00 mark. Non-money events (credit limit, opened) get no bar.
All = indigo outline or 13px medium, not black fill. Rename the filter 'On-chain' or 'Settlements' so it does not equal the mint 'settled' cue.

top_issues: Activity detail Time is '00:27:40' with no date or timezone — it reads as a stopwatch, not a payment time; a 'just now' caption is also stranded under the list.
Activity detail vs Receipt: Frame #41 vs #40; Proof ellipsis …b19265 vs …9265; title PAYMENT · SETTLED vs PAID — same movement, three encodings.
Activity detail To row crams 'Meridian Desk 0x499d0d…f2bd' into one line; Proof and address are not copyable.
Detail panel has no bar for −25.00, so the receipt still does not participate in visceral scale.
fixes: Time: 'Today, 00:27:40 UTC' (or local). Delete the orphan 'just now' under the list.
Receipt modal and this panel share one spec: amount, counterparty, Via, Frame #, time, Proof, 'From your runtime's committed frames'. Same #, same truncation (8+6).
To / Proof: trailing copy glyph, 13px tabular hex. Name and hex on separate rows if needed.
Under −25.00 USDC, a 4px bar at 1 px = $N (2.5 px at $10 — so at this scale show a 1px tick plus the numeric; do not stretch it).

top_issues: Settings SCALE: '1 px = $10' is printed three times (section header right, beside the slider, and on the $10 chip) — the one unique control in the product is noisy.
Settings: the scale slider has no sample bar, so the user cannot see 100 px = $1,000 before Home/Pay fail to honor it.
Settings VAULT: label 'Sandbox' with value 'sandbox'; Reveal recovery phrase and Lock are equal gray pills — recovery is a dangerous peer of Lock.
Settings HOME toggles can hide On-chain / Reserve / Accounts with no preview of how Total balance will change.
fixes: One readout: '1 px = $10' to the right of the slider. Delete the duplicate in the SCALE header.
Under the presets, draw a 120 px sample bar labeled '$1,200 at this scale' plus a 12 px tick. This is the only place a bar may be a legend.
Sandbox: single line 'Vault · sandbox'. Recovery phrase behind a confirm; Lock as the only always-visible footer button.
Toggling a HOME layer live-updates a 40px composition bar in the section so hiding Reserve immediately drops $1,500 from the sample total.

overall.verdict: Light desktop is an acceptable two-column shell (Home, Pay, Activity) with calm type and a real scale control, but it does not ship the product thesis: bars fit their cards, 60k draws shorter than 40k, and Receive/Account are phone columns. Trust is then spent on a leftover 'submitted' toast, a 0.00 Swap quote, and Frame #40 vs #41.
priority_fixes: Apply 1 px = $N everywhere with clip-not-stretch; left send half must be longer than right receive half whenever sendCapacity > receiveCapacity (Home, Pay, Account, Swap).
Kill the 'Payment submitted' toast the moment the receipt is PAID/Settled, and never replay it on Receive/Swap/Account.
Give Receive and Account the Pay/Activity two-column desktop grid; stop centering a 420px phone stack.
Block Swap when You receive is 0.00 — disabled CTA + 'No quote' — and never show a lavender button that looks tappable.
One frame id and one money format: Receipt/Activity/Settings share Frame #; $ vs USDC vs +10,000.00 stop mixing on Home.
